notes.title: Playtest Update – One Week Left to Join!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

A huge thank you to everyone who has joined the playtests for Train Station Project! Your feedback has been incredibly valuable, and we’re thrilled to have such an engaged community.

The playtest will remain available for another week, until [b]March 3, 2025[/b], so there’s still time to join and check out the demo if you haven’t already!

🔹 [b]Why isn’t there a save option?[/b]
Many of you have asked about the lack of a save system. The reason is simple: the demo can be completed in about 60 minutes, and we’re still actively modifying the game’s save files. If we had implemented saving, your progress would quickly become incompatible with updates. However, don’t worry – the public demo coming in a few months will include a save system!

🎯 [b]What was the goal of this playtest?[/b]
Our main objective was to gauge your general impressions and gather feedback on the overall feel of the game. Thanks to your input, we’re confident that everything is moving in the right direction. Keep in mind that the playtest contains only 5% of the full content – we have plenty of surprises for the full release!

📢 [b]Playtest Update: Polish Localization of 3D Assets[/b]
We received numerous requests from Polish players asking for in-game 3D objects to feature Polish text. As a result, we released a quick update to translate a significant portion of these assets. If you’re playing in English, don’t worry – everything remains the same and fully understandable!

Once again, thank you for your support, wishlist additions, and active participation in the playtest. Your enthusiasm and trust mean the world to us! ❤️

See you on the tracks and… on Discord! 🚉💨

notes.title: First Update & Playtest
notes.notes:
[h3]Train Station Project Devlog: First Update & Playtest[/h3]

Welcome to the inaugural developer update for our upcoming game, [b]Train Station Project[/b]. We are incredibly grateful for your interest in our project and are excited to announce that sign-ups for the playtesting phase are now open.

At this stage, we have completed the environment for the main location and implemented all the core mechanics. Our focus in the coming weeks will be on polishing the game to prepare for a public demo release.

As a sneak peek, we’ve included a few concept sketches from our talented concept artist, showcasing the creative process behind the game’s environment. Enjoy!
